verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no native sync of invoices, payments, or recognition entries to QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite, or any GL or ERP. 'Automatic reconciliation' covers cash reconciliation inside Stripe, which is an adjacent feature. CSV export is exactly the manual workaround the story wants to avoid, and the API and webhooks are only building blocks a developer would need to construct a sync.

support.subject: As a finance lead, invoices, payments, and recognition entries sync to my general ledger or ERP — QuickBooks, Xero, NetSuite — so the close doesn't need CSV surgery
